notes: No importable vegetarian Taco Bell Australia meals are proposed because the official Australian FAQ currently says nutritional data is not available for menu items.
Official Australian allergen and suitability data exists at https://tacobell.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Taco-Bell-Allergens-March-2024.pdf, but it does not include calories or protein grams.

The March 2024 allergen PDF marks Black Beans, Seasoned Mexican Rice, lettuce, tomato, tortilla chips, and several tortillas as vegetarian and vegan friendly; dairy items such as sour cream, 4 Cheese Blend, Angel Hair Cheddar, and Nacho Cheese Sauce are ovo-lacto vegetarian, not vegan.
Taco Bell Australia's FAQ says vegetarian-friendly orders can be made by substituting or removing ingredients, and that Mexican seasoned rice and Black Beans are vegetarian and vegan-friendly.

Trap: the allergen PDF has vegetarian Bean variants for items such as Crunchwrap Supreme Beans, Chipotle Crunch Burrito Beans, Burrito Bowl Beans, and Stacked Tortilla Chips Beans, but without official calories_kcal and protein_g these should not be imported into burgerdiet.
Trap: non-Australian Taco Bell nutrition calculators or PDFs, including US and NZ sources, should not be mixed into AU app data because formulations, serving sizes, and menu builds may differ.
Bean, vegetable, and cheese add-ons are intentionally omitted; official Australian suitability exists for some ingredients, but official Australian macro data was not found.
